items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I think it was Dan Burley that wrote this column in the Pittsburgh Courier... I used to read about them in the Pittsburgh Courier... was a guy who wrote for it named Dan Burley who used to write about all of the musicians

ctx.x: He came to New York here. He was in New York.

Yeah, and he had a column that -- I think it was Dan Burley that wrote this column in the Pittsburgh Courier, and they used to have, like, during those days, they used to have, like all of the band, the routes, where they were going, and they had a writeup about all of the different musicians and the entertainers and that.
